The schema, context, XSD files, and license are vendored from gs1/EPCIS commit 6f71468231838e424bb5dfa836e006e8dc69615c. No sample EPCIS events are vendored.

License: [GS1 LICENSE](https://github.com/gs1/EPCIS/blob/6f71468231838e424bb5dfa836e006e8dc69615c/LICENSE); the local LICENSE is an unmodified copy.
